reason: The gap is real, and the timing makes it likely. The poller cadence is ~601.6 s, so headers fall at ~18:20:14Z, ~18:30:16Z and ~18:40:18Z. A typical exp89t completion (18:17-18:29Z) shows up at the 18:20Z or the 18:30Z header. After an 18:30Z header, the S1 save (~18:31Z) plus the one pre-registered lag re-save (+5 min) ends at ~18:36-18:37Z, which is exactly when the 18:37Z timer fires. R39-A7 lists only PENDING/T1..T6, although its own 'why' expects a T3 UP test to be running. The PENDING text would be false after a read, and a T4 'no change' text would come too early. Feasibility is fine. It changes no rule: V_pub stays exp87a until k >= 1, which is the running-champion rule in R38-A5. It adds no Kaggle calls; the 18:37Z SELECTED read is needed anyway, so '0 calls' means 0 extra. The UPWAIT variant already exists in the scan's mk_card_1837.py (between the MKCARD markers), and it passed the dry-all at 13:40Z (45/45). The value is ops-only, with zero effect on the private score. Even without UPWAIT, the promotion line and the 19:43Z R39-A4 reminder would fix a stale tick. The SEND-UPWAIT branch is almost never used. From a header at or before 18:30Z, the worst case (S1, lag re-save, 2 retries 5 min apart) finishes by ~18:48-18:50Z, so the 'hold' branch covers almost every case.
fix: Copy mk_card_1837.py verbatim from scan_hyp_exp89tmsg40.notes.md (<<<MKCARD ... MKCARD>>>) to the scratchpad and log its sha8. Logged rule for the 18:37Z timer: if exp89t read 0.959 and the UP code is not final yet, HOLD the card and send it right after the UP result (T1 promotion variant or T4); do not send both UPWAIT and a promotion minutes apart. Send UPWAIT only if the UP result cannot come by ~18:50Z (a stalled download or retries). If the user answers the 13:21Z open question with 'keep exp87a even with UP', drop UPWAIT's promise line ('Если UP подтвердится, пришлю одну строку'), because UP is then info-only. Keep the 1 read-only SELECTED call before any card, as R38-A5 requires. UPWAIT itself adds 0 calls.
realistic_gain: No effect on the score (public or private). It is an ops guard: it stops a wrong-state 18:37Z card (PENDING after a read, or an early 'no change'). That matters in roughly 10-20% of worlds (0.959 read at the ~18:30Z header while the lag re-save/retry is still running). The 'hold' branch resolves almost all of those by ~18:50Z (21:50 MSK); a sent UPWAIT card is expected in <2% of worlds. It costs a <=13 min card delay, well before the 20:00Z (23:00 MSK) tick.
